parameters.name: Addr
parameters.description: The list of addresses in the address pool.

sub_parameters.name: Mode
sub_parameters.description:
The mode. Valid values:

- **SMART**: Intelligent return

- **ONLINE**: Always online

- **OFFLINE**: Always offline

parameters.name: AddrPoolId
parameters.description: The ID of the address pool.

parameters.name: MinAvailableAddrNum
parameters.description: The minimum number of active addresses in the address pool.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

- IP: IPv4 addresses

- DOMAIN: Domain names
